capabilities.body: I-OpenAmer ihlela umsebenzi, iwuqhube ngamathuluzi angempela — itheminali, isiphequluli, amafayela, ikhodi — njalo igcine okusebenzileyo.
capabilities.title: Umncedisi ocabanga lawe

capabilities.body: Izingxoxo, inkumbulo lamamodeli kuhlala kulo umtshina. Akukho okulayitshwa ku-inthanethi ngaphandle kokuthi ukucele.
capabilities.title: Umtshina wakho, idatha yakho

capabilities.body: Izindimi ezingu-186, ngalunye lubhalwe ngendlela oyifundayo. Isikrini sokuqala sohlelo sikubuza ukuthi ukhetha luphi.
capabilities.title: Ulimi lwakho, ngendlela eqondileyo

capabilities.body: Amakhono agcinwa esuselwa emsebenzini ngokwawo, ngakho imisebenzi yansuku zonke iba mifitshane nxa uqhubeka ulusebenzisa.
capabilities.title: Amandla akhulayo

help: Hlola ukuthi lumtshina uyenelisa ukungena ku-inthanethi.
Qalisa ukusetha futhi — izinyathelo eseziqediwe aziphindwa.
Nxa kwehluleka kabili, vula amarekhodi; imigqa yokucina itsho isinyathelo.
failure.lead: Akulanguquko ezibuyiselwe emuva kungaziswanga — i-OpenAmer ima lapho emiswe khona, ngakho ukuyiqalisa futhi kuyaqhubeka kusukela lapho.
failure.leadUpdate: I-OpenAmer isesenguqulweni edluleyo njalo iyaqhubeka isebenza. Akukho okutshiywe sekutshintshwe ingxenye kuphela.
failure.title: Ukusetha akuqedwanga

language.lead: Ukusetha kuqhubeka ngolimi olukhetha lapha. Ungalutshintsha ngemva kwesikhathi kuhlelo.
language.title: Khetha ulimi lwakho

progress.lead: Ukusetha kanye kuphela: I-OpenAmer ilanda ekudingayo njalo ilungisa lumtshina. Ekuqalisweni okulandelayo konke lokhu kuyeqiwa.
progress.leadUpdate: I-OpenAmer ifaka inguqulo entsha endaweni yedluleyo. Izikhathi zakho zokusebenza, inkumbulo lezilungiselelo akuthintwa.
progress.title: Isetha i-OpenAmer

cards.body: Vula uhlelo uchaze ofuna kwenziwe. I-OpenAmer isebenza ngemuva ibuye ikubikele.
cards.title: Qala ngomutsho

cards.body: Izilungiselelo → Ukubonisa → Ulimi. Izilungiselelo zendimi lezindawo ezingu-186, ungazitshintsha loba nini.
cards.title: Khetha ulimi lwakho

cards.body: Umsebenzi ophindwayo uba likhono — ngesikhathi esilandelayo udinga umlayo owodwa.
cards.title: Yivumele ikhumbule

success.lead: Konke sekulungile. I-OpenAmer isingeyakho — kulo umtshina, ngolimi lwakho.
success.title: I-OpenAmer isilungile

bullets: Isebenza kulo umtshina — izingxoxo zakho zihlala lapha
Izindimi ezingu-186, okugoqela indlela yokubhala oyifundayo
Konke kungatshintshwa ngemva kwesikhathi; akukho okungasoze kutshintshwe
welcome.lead: Umncedisi wakho. Kumtshina wakho. Ngolimi lwakho.
welcome.leadUpdate: Inguqulo entsha ye-OpenAmer isilungile. Izangena endaweni yenguqulo edluleyo igcine zonke izikhathi zokusebenza lezilungiselelo.
welcome.note: Kuthatha imizuzu emilutshwana nxa uxhumano lujayelekile.
welcome.title: Siyakwamukela ku-OpenAmer
